title: National Poverty Mapping & SDG Monitoring Dashboard
client: Ministry of Planning - Government of Kenya
content:
Developed an interactive national poverty mapping system integrating multiple data sources including census data, satellite imagery, and mobile network data to create high-resolution poverty maps at the sub-county level.

## Key Achievements
- **Data Integration**: Combined traditional survey data with alternative data sources including nighttime lights, mobile money transactions, and satellite imagery
- **Predictive Modeling**: Built machine learning models to predict poverty levels in areas with limited survey data
- **Interactive Dashboard**: Created a web-based dashboard allowing policymakers to visualize poverty indicators across 47 counties
- **SDG Alignment**: Mapped poverty indicators to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 1, 2, and 10

## Technical Implementation
- **Data Processing**: Cleaned and harmonized data from 5 different government databases
- **Machine Learning**: Implemented random forest and gradient boosting models with 92% prediction accuracy
- **Visualization**: Built using D3.js and Mapbox for interactive geospatial visualizations
- **Infrastructure**: Deployed on AWS with automated data pipelines for monthly updates

title: Agriculture Value Chain Analysis & Market Intelligence System
content:
Developed a comprehensive market intelligence system for agricultural value chains across 8 East African countries to enhance food security and market efficiency.

## Project Scope
- **Value Chain Mapping**: Analyzed maize, beans, and horticulture value chains from production to consumption
- **Price Monitoring**: Real-time price tracking across 150 markets using mobile data collection
- **Predictive Analytics**: Price forecasting models with 85% accuracy for 30-day predictions
- **Stakeholder Platform**: Digital platform connecting 5,000 farmers with markets and financial services

## Impact Metrics
- **Market Efficiency**: Reduced price disparities between markets by 40%
- **Farmer Income**: Increased smallholder farmer incomes by 25% through better market access
- **Food Waste**: Reduced post-harvest losses by 30% through improved logistics planning
- **Financial Inclusion**: Connected 2,500 farmers to digital financial services

## Technical Features
- **Real-time Data**: Integration with mobile money APIs and SMS-based data collection
- **Predictive Models**: Time series analysis and machine learning for price forecasting
- **Mobile Application**: Android app for field agents with offline data collection capabilities
- **API Integration**: RESTful APIs for third-party system integration

title: Healthcare Supply Chain Optimization & Predictive Inventory Management
content:
Designed and implemented a predictive inventory management system for essential medicines across 12 African countries to reduce stockouts and optimize healthcare supply chains.

## Problem Statement
Healthcare facilities in sub-Saharan Africa experience medicine stockouts 40% of the time, leading to preventable deaths and treatment interruptions.

## Solution Components
1. **Demand Forecasting**: Machine learning models predicting medicine demand based on historical data, disease outbreaks, and seasonal patterns
2. **Supply Chain Optimization**: Route optimization algorithms for last-mile delivery to remote facilities
3. **Real-time Monitoring**: IoT-enabled temperature monitoring for vaccine cold chain management
4. **Early Warning System**: Predictive alerts for potential stockouts 30 days in advance

## Results Achieved
- **Stockout Reduction**: Decreased stockouts from 40% to 8% across pilot facilities
- **Cost Savings**: Reduced inventory holding costs by 35%
- **Waste Reduction**: Decreased medicine expiry waste by 60%
- **Delivery Efficiency**: Improved on-time delivery from 65% to 92%

## Technology Stack
- **Backend**: Python/Flask with PostgreSQL database
- **Machine Learning**: Scikit-learn and Prophet for time series forecasting
- **Frontend**: React.js with real-time dashboard
- **Mobile**: Cross-platform mobile app for field inventory management
- **Cloud**: Azure deployment with container orchestration

title: Financial Inclusion Analytics for Microfinance Institutions
content:
Developed credit scoring models and customer segmentation analytics for microfinance institutions serving low-income populations in East Africa.

## Business Challenge
Traditional credit scoring models fail in low-income markets due to lack of formal credit history. Our solution leverages alternative data sources to assess creditworthiness.

## Data Sources Utilized
- **Mobile Money Transactions**: Analysis of payment patterns and transaction frequency
- **Social Network Analysis**: Connections and referral patterns within customer networks
- **Geospatial Data**: Location-based insights on economic activity
- **Psychometric Testing**: Innovative assessment of character and capacity
- **Utility Payments**: History of regular bill payments

## Model Performance
- **Default Prediction**: 78% accuracy in predicting loan defaults (vs. 52% for traditional models)
- **Customer Segmentation**: Identified 5 distinct customer segments with different risk profiles
- **Portfolio Optimization**: Recommended portfolio mix reducing overall risk by 40%
- **Digital Onboarding**: Reduced loan application processing from 2 weeks to 24 hours

## Implementation Impact
- **Increased Access**: Extended credit to 150,000 previously unbanked individuals
- **Reduced Risk**: Lowered default rates from 15% to 8%
- **Cost Reduction**: Decreased customer acquisition cost by 35%
- **Gender Inclusion**: 45% of new customers were women, addressing gender gaps in financial access

title: Education Quality Monitoring & Learning Outcomes Predictive Analytics
content:
Implemented a comprehensive education monitoring system tracking learning outcomes, teacher performance, and resource allocation across 3,000 schools in Tanzania.

## System Components

### 1. Learning Assessment Platform
- Digital testing platform for standardized assessments
- Real-time scoring and analytics
- Adaptive testing based on student performance

### 2. Teacher Performance Monitoring
- Classroom observation tools using tablet applications
- Professional development tracking
- Performance analytics and benchmarking

### 3. Resource Allocation Optimization
- Predictive models for textbook distribution
- Infrastructure needs assessment
- Budget optimization algorithms

### 4. Early Warning System
- Identification of at-risk students
- Dropout prediction models
- Intervention recommendation engine

## Key Outcomes
- **Learning Improvement**: 22% increase in mathematics scores in pilot schools
- **Teacher Effectiveness**: 35% improvement in teaching methodologies
- **Resource Efficiency**: 40% reduction in textbook shortages
- **Dropout Reduction**: Early identification reduced dropout rates by 18%

## Technical Implementation
- **Mobile Data Collection**: Offline-capable Android apps for field data collection
- **Predictive Analytics**: Machine learning models for dropout prediction
- **Data Visualization**: Interactive dashboards for district education officers
- **API Integration**: Integration with existing government education management systems

title: Climate Change Vulnerability Assessment & Adaptation Planning Platform
content:
Developed a comprehensive climate vulnerability assessment platform integrating climate models, socioeconomic data, and geospatial analytics for adaptation planning across 15 African countries.

## Platform Capabilities

### 1. Climate Risk Assessment
- Integration of IPCC climate models with downscaled regional projections
- Multi-hazard risk mapping (droughts, floods, heatwaves)
- Sector-specific vulnerability assessments (agriculture, water, health)

### 2. Adaptation Planning Support
- Cost-benefit analysis of adaptation options
- Prioritization framework for adaptation investments
- Monitoring and evaluation framework for adaptation projects

### 3. Early Warning Systems
- Predictive analytics for climate-related disasters
- Automated alert systems for at-risk communities
- Impact-based forecasting for decision support

### 4. Knowledge Platform
- Repository of adaptation case studies and best practices
- Community of practice for climate experts
- Training materials and capacity building resources

## Scientific Innovation
- **Downscaling Models**: Developed statistical downscaling techniques for high-resolution climate projections
- **Vulnerability Indices**: Created composite vulnerability indices combining 35 indicators
- **Machine Learning**: Applied ML to identify vulnerable populations and hotspots
- **Scenario Analysis**: Developed multiple climate and socioeconomic scenarios for robust planning

## Impact & Adoption
- **Policy Integration**: Adopted by 8 national governments for climate planning
- **Funding Mobilized**: Platform supported $150M in climate adaptation funding
- **Capacity Building**: Trained 500+ government officials on climate analytics
- **Research Contribution**: 12 peer-reviewed publications from project data
